claude.result:
All changes are ready. Here's a summary of what I've implemented:

## Weekly Subscriptions Added to Subtrack

✅ **CLI Command**: `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works
- Updated USAGE to show `--every week|month|year` option
- Extended EVERY mapping to accept "week" and "weekly"
- Updated validation error messages

✅ **Monthly Cost Calculation**: Weekly plans cost price × 52÷12 a month, rounded to nearest cent
- €12/week = €52.00/month (exactly as specified)
- €59.90/week = €259.57/month
- Uses `Math.round()` for weekly (not `Math.floor()` like monthly/yearly)

✅ **Charging Schedule**: Weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since` date
- Modified `nextCharge()` function to handle 7-day intervals for weekly plans
- Each renewal falls exactly 7 days after the previous one

✅ **Renewals Command**: `subtrack renewals` lists weekly plans alongside monthly/yearly
- Fixed sorting bug: now sorts by date field (ISO format) instead of short label (string format)
- This fix also improves accuracy for all plan types

✅ **Tests**: Added 2 new test cases
- Weekly plan monthly cost calculation with rounding
- Weekly plan charging every 7 days

All 36 tests pass, including the original 34 and the 2 new ones. Ready to commit!
